columns.pair: adjacent flight-line pair index in the synthetic network, dimensionless
columns.P: the pair's fitted slope (c_A+c_B)/2, mm per unit tangent
columns.dP: change in P under the candidate null direction, mm per unit tangent
columns.dK: change in K under the candidate null direction, mm
columns.line: flight line index in the synthetic network, dimensionless
columns.dc: change in that line's across-track coefficient under the direction, mm per unit tangent
columns.da: change in that line's nadir offset under the direction, mm
columns.tile: derived-product directory the overlap cells come from
columns.sd_sum: standard deviation of tan(scan_A)+tan(scan_B) over those cells
columns.sd_dif: standard deviation of tan(scan_A)-tan(scan_B) over those cells
columns.p_se: its cluster-robust standard error, mm per unit tangent
columns.q_mm: fitted (c_A-c_B)/2, mm per unit tangent -- the degenerate combination
columns.q_se: its cluster-robust standard error, mm per unit tangent
columns.se_ratio: q_se / p_se: how many times worse the degenerate combination is known
columns.dsum_dz: OLS slope of tan(scan_A)+tan(scan_B) on the gen2 ground elevation of the same cell, per metre
columns.dsum_dz_pred: the value predicted by geometry, mean(sum_tan)/(h - mean z), per metre
columns.psid_mark: the gen1 flight line that overflies the mark
columns.offnadir: the mark's distance from that line's fitted nadir track, m
columns.tan_mark: tan of the scan angle at which that line sees the mark = offnadir / h
columns.tie: surveyed - gen1, mm (the constant to ADD to gen1)
columns.tie_sigma: that tie's own standard error, mm
columns.c_effect: how much a per-line coefficient of 130 mm per unit tangent moves the tie at that mark: 130 * tan_mark, mm
